blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The northeast monsoon, or amihan, is forecast to bring rains over Extreme Northern Luzon, while two other weather systems may affect parts of the country on Thursday, Nov. 19, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the northeast monsoon may bring partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated light rains over Batanes and the Babuyan Islands.
